name: Today (live)
desc: Hit rate after every round on a pale chart over the dark sunburst, four rows with the odds a coin does as well. No money anywhere.

name: A · Still afloat? (pick)
desc: Out of the Fog, made the P&L: break-even is the sea's surface in the painting, aligned at every width. Profit sails in the moonlight, losses sink. Tide-pole axis, buoys at the line ends, lantern windows, the harbour log on planks (a plank in the red rides low in the water).

name: B · Flying high?
desc: Break-even is the cloud deck: profit flies in the clear sky, losses are down in the storm. Each line a contrail ending at a plane in its AI's colour, nose along its last move. Cockpit toggles for the windows, flight strips for the rows.

name: C · The money trail
desc: A chart recorder running all season: the drum on desktop, a paper strip unrolling downward on a phone (round 1 at the top, newest at the bottom). Each AI's pen leaves its ink; brass tags with arms to each line's end. Rotary knob for the windows, brass plates with odometer counters for the rows.

name: D · Follow the money
desc: The ops room: lines plotted in grease pencil on the big glass board, break-even a strip of tape, the leader traced over in gold. Lit desk switches for the windows, the tote board (every figure in slotted tiles) for the rows.

name: E · In the green?
desc: The NVIDIA chip's own circuit board: break-even is the board's gold bus bar, the loss zone below it tinted red. Each P&L a copper trace with its colour inlaid, a green or red LED at its end, a slow current along the leader's trace. DIP switch windows, the rows as four chips.
